facts.text: Sir Alfred lies broken and incapacitated but not destroyed in the Barrow Mound. He may recover and kill more Free Goblin Society members settling there.
Why does the undead knight Sir Alfred roam the Barrow Mound, and why does Brother Dirk regard him as holy?
